preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of rooms n in each test case must be between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '<>-' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters '<', '>', and '-'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of returnable rooms for each test case.
